compliance.summary: The GoGloby listing and banner present the company as a marketing recruitment and staffing provider, not a Data & AI Engineers staffing and recruiting agency. Edit the GoGloby-specific claims, and correct or remove the unsupported facts and offers; the rest of the agency comparison is not being audited here.

llm_problems.title: GoGloby's service positioning is wrong
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Services
llm_problems.issue: The page describes GoGloby as a marketing recruitment and staffing agency, while the approved description and services are specifically about hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Change the GoGloby-specific descriptions to reflect its approved company description and services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting Data & AI Engineers

locations.reason: The FAQ claims GoGloby specializes in placing remote marketers.

llm_problems.title: Marketing buyers are the wrong audience
llm_problems.issue: The GoGloby-specific copy courts companies seeking marketing hires, an audience and role category outside GoGloby's stated focus on engineering hires.
